plugin.smartModelRouter.label: Smart scheduling
plugin.smartModelRouter.desc: When enabled, Auto appears in the model picker. Selecting Auto automatically chooses the model and reasoning effort for each turn.
plugin.smartModelRouter.settings.descrip: Smart scheduling adds Auto to the model list. After you select Auto, it automatically chooses a suitable model and reasoning effort for each turn, adapting to different use cases while reducing usage and wait time.
plugin.smartModelRouter.settings.disable: Smart scheduling is off. Enable it from Settings → Plugins on the OpenCodex sign-in page.
plugin.smartModelRouter.settings.missing: Smart scheduling configuration was not found.
plugin.smartModelRouter.settings.unavail: Temporarily unavailable for this account; routing will fall back automatically.
plugin.smartModelRouter.settings.conflic: Another page changed this configuration. The latest revision was loaded; please retry.
plugin.smartModelRouter.tiers.title: Tiers
plugin.smartModelRouter.tiers.descriptio: Tiers are ordered from lowest to highest capability. Built-ins allow model and reasoning effort changes, and only enabled tiers participate in classification.
plugin.smartModelRouter.tiers.noneEnable: No tiers are enabled. Auto will use the fallback route directly.
plugin.smartModelRouter.tier.name: Name
plugin.smartModelRouter.tier.newPrompt: Describe which tasks should select this tier.
plugin.smartModelRouter.summary.title: Smart scheduling
plugin.smartModelRouter.health.title: Feature health
plugin.smartModelRouter.setting.showRout: While Auto is enabled, keep the most recently scheduled model and reasoning effort visible in the task summary.
